mentions.name: Kerns
mentions.description: A research environment for deeply understanding topics across multiple sources. Users upload papers, articles, or books into a workspace that persists across sessions, read with AI summaries that let them zoom in and out of documents, generate knowledge maps to visualize how ideas connect, and run deep research agents that produce comprehensive, cited reports. Free to use.
mentions.audience: Anyone doing heavy reading and research
